text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
It has arrived once again this year! 
Bringing together powerhouse contenders 
from home and abroad, the international 
invitational race, the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
They say this year features a "super" 
stellar lineup! What do you think?!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Led by her—a true dark 
horse— the roster of international runners 
is stacked...!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore! The domestic participants are 
all top-tier powerhouses as well!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Outrunning an elite field hailed as "the 
greatest" with "the greatest" late-race 
burst! Last year's Derby girl, Eishin 
Flash!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
“Tosen Jordan strikes from behind with an 
astonishing record in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!”

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
And—of course, it wouldn't be complete 
without her!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: The Queen, Buena Vista!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
She achieved the Double Crown on the Tiara 
route and conquered numerous GⅠ races in 
her Senior Class year! Her rock-solid 
consistency earned her the title of 
Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
This past year...! Since last year's 
Autumn Tenno Sho, she has been kept away 
from victory, but—

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
She will surely make her triumphant return 
today! She's going to prove she's the 
strongest active Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected, they're really pushing you 
hard, huh...! Buenavista-san.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: No, but in reality—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ‘Daaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!’

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And with that, her eyes became glued to 
the race footage that was inserted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Straightforward eyes filled with earnest 
devotion, yet radiating an unyielding 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A beautiful, sweeping form. A tremendous 
closing kick that reveals undeniable 
talent. Above all——

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOO...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheers that completely enveloped and shook 
Tokyo Racecourse. A massive, overflowing 
love that could be felt even through the 
screen—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...A-Amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I knew she was well-liked, but to think it 
was to this extent...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(I ran out in the heat of the moment, but 
can I really――)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(............Wait, I'm losing my 
nerve...!)
choice_data_list:
We won't know for sure until we try 
running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I knew the Japan Cup was on a whole 
different level. That's why I did thorough 
research beforehand.
choice_data_list: Let's review the race plan one last time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, I pulled out and spread open 
the rather thick stack of documents that 
she and I had looked over countless times 
for today.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah..., Y-You're right! It's not over yet!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Right. Trainer is trying so hard for my 
sake.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Buena-san is amazing, for sure, but... If 
I shake off this cold feet and do my best 
like always, even I can surely—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (I know it...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, making their appearances one after 
another are the Umamusume running in the 
Japan Cup—and!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOO...!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The roar of the crowd! What an enormous 
cheer! A chorus of adoration for Buena 
Vista, right now!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I have spent my days pathetically. Running 
only races where I failed to live up to 
everyone's hopes.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why today, on this 
grand stage. Please let me make a promise 
to you..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Right here, without fail—I'll show 
everyone. An endless, "magnificent 
view"...!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Please let the love and kindness you have 
shown me become my strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as Buena Vista took a bow, 
thunderous applause washed over her.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh! Truly overwhelming. Her words, 
her posture, ...and the cheers—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Shion-sanâ

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...! I-I'm looking forward to working with 
you today!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Likewise. Now, today we'll be—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I will make sure to burn an unforgettable 
image of myself into all of your hearts.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Well then, see you on the turf...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Every single word carries such weight...! 
I see, so that resolve—brought about those 
cheers...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...I might get... swallowed up...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(—Agh, losing confidence again! No good. 
Clear your mind—get rid of it...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(If I try my hardest, it'll be fine. As 
long as I give it my all, it'll all be 
okay...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the echoes of applause could even 
settle, the curtain rose on the Japan 
Cup...!
